intro: Brother Wilhelm is a human paladin trainer stationed in Goldshire within Elwynn Forest. Tucked away behind the village blacksmith, he instructs young defenders of the Holy Light taking their first steps outside Northshire Abbey.

p: While Northshire Valley provides initial shelter for fledgling champions of the Light, those stepping into the broader world of Elwynn Forest often seek out Brother Wilhelm. Stationed just behind the busy smithy in Goldshire, he trains newly minted paladins in their sacred duties, providing guidance and lessons as they transition from abbey novices to sworn protectors of the realm.

Wilhelm plays a crucial role in directing aspiring paladins along their holy journey, helping them seek out the Tome of Divinity. Through this vital rite, initiates learn the weight of sacrifice and the power of divine redemption, testing their devotion so they may wield the Light to resurrect fallen comrades and uphold justice across the Kingdom of Stormwind.
